name: DramaProject
description: Private story studio project with confirmation-gated setup, screenplay, character profiles, hosted frame assets, single-shot motion clips, and private voice timing takes

orientation.description: Selected output orientation: vertical or horizontal

total_episodes.description: Requested episode count mapped to the current scene count (3 to 6)

art_style.description: Selected visual art style preset name

global_style.description: Selected visual style preset or custom global rendering prompt

scene_count.description: Target number of scenes (3 to 6), currently mapped from total_episodes

status.description: Workflow status: PENDING, AWAITING_SETUP_CONFIRM, AWAITING_SCRIPT_CONFIRM, SCRIPTED, or FAILED

synopsis.description: Approved story synopsis shown before screenplay generation

production_approved.description: Whether the creator approved the screenplay and unlocked manual media rendering

production_approved_at.description: ISO timestamp when manual media rendering was approved

seed.description: Locked random integer seed for consistency across future media passes

manifest.description: Complete movie manifest containing project_title, global_style, characters, and scenes; each scene may include optional dialogue_lines with line_id, character_id, text, and sequential order, while dialogue remains the joined compatibility text

last_error.description: Failure details if setup or script generation failed

frame_status.description: Hosted frame stage status: NOT_STARTED, GENERATING, READY, FAILED

frame_assets.description: Saved character reference and scene storyboard image metadata

character_id.description: Manifest character ID for a character reference

scene_number.description: Manifest scene number for a storyboard

prompt.description: Prompt used to create the image

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the image was saved

reference_character_ids.description: Character IDs used as scene image references

reference_image_urls.description: Saved character reference URLs used for a scene

frame_error.description: Friendly failure details for the hosted frame stage

video_status.description: Single-shot motion stage status: NOT_STARTED, QUEUED, PROCESSING, READY, FAILED

video_clips.description: Saved Luma-through-Replicate motion test metadata for scene storyboards

scene_number.description: Manifest scene number for this motion clip

source_storyboard_url.description: Exact saved storyboard URL used as the first frame

prompt.description: Cinematic motion prompt sent to the provider

duration_seconds.description: Motion test duration in seconds, fixed at 5

status.description: Clip state: QUEUED, PROCESSING, READY, FAILED

video_url.description: Managed private video URL, present only after READY

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the prediction was created

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the clip state last changed

error.description: Friendly failure details for this motion clip

video_error.description: Friendly failure details for the current motion stage

preview_metadata.description: Optional saved silent hard-cut preview playlist definition, storing scene order and clip IDs without duplicating video URLs

status.description: Preview state: NOT_STARTED, READY, or STALE

scene_numbers.description: Ordered manifest scene numbers included in the preview

clip_prediction_ids.description: Ordered motion prediction IDs selected for the preview

total_duration_seconds.description: Total duration of the selected scene clips in seconds

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the preview definition was saved or marked stale

voice_assignments.description: Saved ElevenLabs voice choices per character for future consistent dialogue generation

voice_name.description: Voice name shown in the creator's library

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when this assignment was saved

audio_assets.description: Latest private ElevenLabs dialogue take metadata per scene and speaker line; legacy assets without line_id use the deterministic first-line fallback

line_id.description: Stable speaker line ID; legacy records may omit it and normalize to scene-<number>-line-1

character_id.description: Selected focused character ID for this line

voice_name.description: Voice name used for this take

text.description: Exact saved scene dialogue used for synthesis

content_type.description: Archived audio content type, normally audio/mpeg

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the take was archived

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the take metadata last changed

error.description: Optional friendly note if timing metadata could not be saved

ambience_assets.description: Latest saved private ElevenLabs room-tone and environmental ambience bed per screenplay scene; records contain READY metadata and managed private audio URLs only

scene_number.description: Manifest scene number for this ambience bed

prompt.description: Bounded room-tone or environmental ambience prompt used for generation

duration_seconds.description: Requested ambience bed duration in seconds

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the ambience bed was archived

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the ambience metadata was saved

error.description: Optional friendly generation or timing note

lipsync_assets.description: Private production lip-sync attempts kept separately from source motion and dialogue arrays; PixVerse is the default for dialogue close-up coverage, Sync remains the ordinary motion-clip path and close-up fallback, and older READY attempts remain archived alongside later processing or failed attempts

provider.description: replicate-lipsync for Sync motion clips or fallback close-ups, or pixverse-lipsync for default dialogue close-up coverage

line_id.description: Exact approved dialogue line identifier, including the deterministic legacy fallback

character_id.description: Approved speaker character ID for the dialogue line

text.description: Exact approved dialogue text used by the saved source take

source_clip_prediction_id.description: READY Luma motion or dialogue close-up prediction used as the lip-sync video source

source_video_url.description: Exact private managed Luma motion or dialogue close-up video URL used as the lip-sync source

source_audio_url.description: Exact private managed ElevenLabs MP3 URL used as the lip-sync source

source_audio_content_type.description: Saved source audio content type, audio/mpeg

status.description: Render state: PROCESSING, READY, FAILED, or CANCELED

remote_status.description: Safe normalized status from the selected lip-sync provider

video_url.description: Private managed MP4 URL, present only after READY

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the lip-sync prediction was started

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the lip-sync metadata last changed

error.description: Bounded friendly failure detail, never provider secrets or raw media data

pixverse_lipsync_assets.description: Private PixVerse lip-sync A/B render attempts kept isolated from production-default lipsync_assets and automatic coverage

line_id.description: Exact approved dialogue line identifier, including the deterministic legacy fallback

character_id.description: Approved speaker character ID for the dialogue line

text.description: Exact approved dialogue text used by the saved source take

source_clip_prediction_id.description: READY dialogue close-up prediction used as the PixVerse video source

source_video_url.description: Exact private managed dialogue close-up video URL used as the PixVerse source

source_audio_url.description: Exact private managed ElevenLabs MP3 URL used as the PixVerse source

source_audio_content_type.description: Saved source audio content type, audio/mpeg

status.description: Render state: PROCESSING, READY, FAILED, or CANCELED

video_url.description: Private managed MP4 URL, present only after READY

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the PixVerse prediction was started

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the PixVerse metadata last changed

error.description: Bounded friendly PixVerse failure detail, never provider secrets or raw media data

dialogue_shot_clips.description: Private dialogue close-up source clip attempts kept separately from scene motion, preview, audio, ambience, and lip-sync assets

prediction_id.description: Provider prediction identifier for this close-up attempt

character_id.description: Approved speaker character ID for the dialogue line

text.description: Exact approved dialogue text used for this close-up

source_frame_type.description: Source frame kind: scene_storyboard or character_reference

source_frame_url.description: Exact private HTTPS storyboard or character reference URL used as the source frame

prompt.description: Cinematic close-up prompt sent to the provider

duration_seconds.description: Close-up source clip duration in seconds

status.description: Clip state: QUEUED, PROCESSING, READY, FAILED, or CANCELED

video_url.description: Private HTTPS managed video URL, present only after READY

content_type.description: Archived video content type, normally video/mp4

bytes.description: Archived video size in bytes when available

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the close-up metadata last changed

completed_at.description: ISO timestamp when the close-up attempt completed, when available

assembly_assets.description: Immutable creator-owned browser final-scene assembly attempts; each record is one WebM render handoff and keeps PROCESSING, READY, or FAILED history without storing media binaries

assembly_id.description: Unique immutable identifier for this browser assembly attempt

version.description: Final assembly metadata schema version, currently 1

status.description: Assembly state: PROCESSING, READY, or FAILED

shot_plan_source_signature.description: Opaque source signature copied from the approved version-2 shot plan

shot_plan_updated_at.description: Shot-plan timestamp used by this assembly attempt

shot_prediction_ids.description: Ordered shot prediction IDs copied from the approved shot plan

shot_count.description: Number of ordered shots included in the browser assembly

total_duration_seconds.description: Total supplied duration of the ordered shots in seconds

file_name.description: Bounded suggested WebM file name for this assembly

video_url.description: Managed private HTTPS WebM URL, present only after READY

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when this assembly attempt last changed

mode.description: Shot plan mode: one_line_hard_cut or multi_line_hard_cut

line_id.description: Current screenplay dialogue line identifier for a version 1 plan

character_id.description: Current screenplay speaker character identifier for a version 1 plan
